name: Rest
description: Sleeps, reads, stares at the ceiling. Recovers from stress much faster.

name: Infirmary
description: Tends the wounded: they heal faster and the group calms down. Can treat someone on the spot, for extra medicine.

name: Kitchen
description: Stretches the rations (each cook saves a fifth; with the pantry, up to 55% in all). A hot meal lowers everyone's stress.

name: Workshop
description: Strips scrap (3 scrap → 1 component every 2 h) and speeds up crafting with Craft.

name: Guard
description: Watches the entrance. If there's a raid, defends with Endurance and Nerve.

name: Radio assistant
description: Sweeps the dial while you're away, and is there when scheduled bulletins air (food drops, warnings, stashes). The company calms everyone.

name: Training
description: Trains with the others. Whoever knows more teaches.

name: Restore
description: Digs out and rebuilds the room you picked in BUNKER → ROOMS. More hands, faster.

name: Lookout
description: Watches through the periscope: raids are seen coming and met with more defense.

name: Sorting
description: Takes scrap apart for parts (4 scrap → 1 part every 3 h).

name: Teaching
description: Teaches whoever's home: everyone slowly improves their weakest skill.

name: Music
description: Plays in the evenings. Everyone at home unwinds.

name: Hydroponics
description: Tends the grow trays: a little food every hour, never more than a quarter of what the crew eats. Uses reserve for the lamps. Blight happens.
